tool_usage_guide.overview: Specific guidance on using Bob's tools effectively for ConcertDef SBOM generation.

priority.when: First step - identify available scan reports
priority.why: Need to know what input files are available before processing
Must read scan report contents to extract component information
priority.note: Read multiple scan reports at once (up to 5 files) for efficiency

priority.when: Creating the SBOM JSON file and documentation
priority.why: Generate the complete ConcertDef SBOM file and documentation

tool.name: list_files

best_practices.practice: Use recursive listing to find reports in subdirectories
Look for common scan report patterns

tool.purpose: Read scan report contents and extract component data

Parse JSON structure to identify scanner type
Extract all relevant component information in one pass

tool.purpose: Find specific patterns in scan reports
tool.when_to_use: When you need to find specific information across multiple files, such as all container image references or repository URLs

tool.purpose: Create the ConcertDef SBOM JSON file

critical_requirements.requirement: MUST include all required ConcertDef fields

best_practices.practice: Format JSON with proper indentation (2 spaces)
Double-check all bom-ref values are unique

when_to_use.scenario: Multiple scan reports found, need clarification
Extract specific data from scan reports

When user wants to upload scan reports to Concert

Validate SBOM structure and fix any schema violations

Check error message and Concert API status

mcp_upload_workflow.description: Complete workflow for uploading generated SBOM and scan reports to IBM Concert

prerequisites.prerequisite: Concert MCP server is configured and running
Concert API credentials are set in config.json
SBOM file has been generated and validated

parameters.parameter: file_path: Path to generated SBOM JSON file
file_path: Path to scan report file
scanner_name: Scanner type (trivy, snyk, grype, etc.)

step.details: Add upload confirmation to generation documentation: - Upload timestamp - Files uploaded - Upload status (success/failure) - Any error messages

efficiency_tips.tip: Read multiple scan reports in a single read_file call
Use search_files to quickly locate specific patterns across files
Validate JSON with jq before finalizing SBOM
Generate timestamp dynamically rather than hardcoding
Create both SBOM and documentation in same workflow
